`GET /groups/:id/-/virtual_registries/cleanup/policy` · [docs](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/virtual_registries_cleanup_policies/#retrieve-the-cleanup-policy-for-a-group)

| Attribute | In | Type | Required | Default | Values | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string or integer | yes |  |  |  |

### Create a cleanup policy

`POST /groups/:id/-/virtual_registries/cleanup/policy` · [docs](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/virtual_registries_cleanup_policies/#create-a-cleanup-policy)

| Attribute | In | Type | Required | Default | Values | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string or integer | yes |  |  |  |
| `cadence` | body | integer |  |  | `1`, `7`, `14`, `30`, `90` |  |
| `enabled` | body | boolean |  |  |  |  |
| `keep_n_days_after_download` | body | integer |  |  |  |  |
| `notify_on_success` | body | boolean |  |  |  |  |
| `notify_on_failure` | body | boolean |  |  |  |  |
